sqliteSql: SELECT category_id,ROUND(1.0*sales_cost_cents/NULLIF((opening_cents+closing_cents)/2.0,0),2) AS turnover,ROUND(365.0/NULLIF(1.0*sales_cost_cents/NULLIF((opening_cents+closing_cents)/2.0,0),0),2) AS days FROM inv_cost ORDER BY category_id
